import numpy as np

crop = im23[350:, 300:]

# Let's find unique RGB colors in that region
legs_mask = (im23[:,:,0] < 80) & (im23[:,:,1] < 80) & (im23[:,:,2] < 80) & (im23[:,:,0] > 40)
coords = np.argwhere(legs_mask)

stool_pts = [c for c in coords if c[0] > 400 and c[1] > 300]
if stool_pts:
    stool_pts = np.array(stool_pts)
